# CNBC TV18

> > India's premier business news platform delivering real-time stock market updates, financial news, and economic coverage across English and Hindi.

CNBC TV18 is a comprehensive business and financial news portal covering Indian and global markets, with dedicated sections for stock market data, IPOs, personal finance, and breaking news. The platform serves investors, traders, and general news readers with live updates on NSE/BSE, commodities, and geopolitical developments affecting markets.

## Key Topics

- Stock Market News
- NSE/BSE
- Nifty 50
- IPO News
- HDFC Bank
- Market Updates
- Personal Finance
- India News
- Business News
- Live Updates
- Commodities
- Financial Planning
- Breaking News
- Economy News
- Tata Group

## Core News & Markets

- [Homepage](https://www.cnbctv18.com): Homepage with stock market, business news, HDFC Bank updates, Nifty 50
- [Latest News](https://www.cnbctv18.com/latest-news): Latest news aggregator covering business, market updates, India news
- [Live Updates](https://www.cnbctv18.com/live-updates): Real-time market, business, and geopolitical event coverage with live updates
- [Business News](https://www.cnbctv18.com/business): Business news section with HDFC Bank, JSW, corporate earnings coverage

## Stock Market & Trading

- [Stock Market Hub](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market): Stock market hub with BSE/NSE, Sensex, Nifty 50, IPO news coverage
- [Stock Directory](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks): Stock directory with NSE/BSE listings, prices, and company information
- [IPO Calendar & Tracker](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/ipo): IPO calendar, tracker with GMP, price bands, subscription status

## Finance & Economy

- [Personal Finance](https://www.cnbctv18.com/personal-finance): Personal finance guide covering investing, taxes, insurance, retirement planning
- [Economy News](https://www.cnbctv18.com/economy): Indian and global economy news with GDP, trade, currency reserves coverage

## News & Current Affairs

- [India News](https://www.cnbctv18.com/india): India news portal with politics, government, Supreme Court coverage
- [World News](https://www.cnbctv18.com/world): International news with geopolitical conflicts, West Asia crisis coverage

## Hindi Business News

- [CNBC Awaaz - Hindi Portal](https://hindi.cnbctv18.com): Hindi business news portal with stock market, IPO, Tata Group coverage

## Multimedia & Quick Reads

- [Videos](https://www.cnbctv18.com/videos): Video news content on business, markets, geopolitics, commodities analysis
- [Photo Gallery](https://www.cnbctv18.com/photos): Photo gallery with business, market, entertainment, auto industry news
- [Quick Reads](https://www.cnbctv18.com/minis): Quick news digest covering business, automotive, finance, startups
- [Web Stories](https://www.cnbctv18.com/webstories): Visual web stories on business, politics, entertainment, mobile-optimized

## Optional

- [Reader Polls](https://www.cnbctv18.com/poll): Reader polls on RBI rates, stocks, market sentiment, political issues
